'''Miguel Tarin Vegas''' (also published as Miguel Tarin) of Madrid, Spain won the [[2000 Ithor Regionals]].<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref> He finished 6th at the [[2021 Retro Event (Premiere to Death Star II)]] on GEMP.<ref name="pds2">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-retro-event-top-8-pds2/ 2021-05 Retro Event (Top 8 – PDS2)], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016153822/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2021-retro-event-top-8-pds2.html Internet Archive]</ref>
